An incredible survival experience! The concept of being shrunk down in your own backyard is super original and perfectly executed. Every blade of grass feels like a tree, every ant feels like a boss fight.

The exploration, crafting, and base building systems are extremely satisfying, and the game really shines in co-op — working together to survive spider attacks or gather resources is pure fun.

I also love how the game mixes adventure, mystery, and light horror without ever feeling too heavy. Plus, the devs have added tons of updates since launch, keeping the game alive and fresh.

If you enjoy survival games with creativity, teamwork, and a unique atmosphere — Grounded is absolutely worth it!

Absolutely love this game. It's actually difficult. Makes you plan trips. And not too buggy. (pun not intended) I recommend a guide for new players because there are a LOT of mechanics in order to get good, but it is still easy enough to learn just by playing.

Really enjoy this game only major issues I have is some minor bugs like arrows getting lost inside of rocks. Another issue I have is with the sap collector only being able to collect 5 sap in total I feel like something of that size should be able to carry far more. Other than that the game is very fun combat is a little rough at times but as long as you block decently you can kill nearly everything. The progression may not be completely apparent immediately but put some work in and you will get where you need.

Have been playing this game on and off for years on Xbox and then on PC.
The full finished game is amazing and with new game plus there is alot of replay.
Really fun game, gives honey I shrunk the kids! 10/10, hope number 2 is just as good :)
This game is a great way to invite a new gamer with little experience into the world. It is a lot of fun, and has a lot of great moments.

Amazing game with so much to do. I played this during beta and they improved so much! After the first "round" the game can get a bit grindy and repetitive but still fun nonetheless. Great game to introduce to someone who first starting out.

Polished, satisfying, deep & replayable. This is by far the best narrative driven survival game I've ever played with an incredibly beautiful and well crafted open world to explore and conquer.
Review: https://youtu.be/c5vmBSNPMO8?si=FuN4qGuUuT0YJyeY

Game is so addicting! It has base building mechanics, survival mechanics, story components (that is actually compelling and I WANT to know what happens), and best of all...hands down the best QoL (Quality of Life) features to make building, storage management, and overall game play so much nicer than any game I have played period! Highly recommend! I saw the game off and on in Steam but never paid it much attention until I watched Cohh Carnage play again to prep for Grounded 2. I really wish I had picked the game up sooner.

One of the best survival craft games going at the moment, They've got the inventory system down to a fine art and every other game should take notes. The building is great and satisfying, the map is huge and highly detailed, not everything needs to be procedural! The enemies and combat are varied and super well designed as well, weaknesses and resistances are a much appreciated feature that really helps you experience all fighting styles.

I loved it so much on gamepass that I bought it here as well. Would definitely recommend to anyone who's looking for that next early minecraft level of experience with friends.
Rich story, great voicing, and engaging gameplay. Dev's have still been putting out amazing updates that bring both quality of life and content into this already amazing game.
Fun game played with my wife the entire time. almost everything could use some tweaking but overall its a fun well rounded game.

Honestly one of the best co op open world survival games I've played. The world is a blast to explore. Only complaint is it's a bit grindy towards the end especially if you play on "WHOA!" difficulty.

closest I came to touching grass since the covid lockdown

it perfectly fills that "Honey, I Shrunk The Kids" hole in my heart I had since childhood. and the sound design is amazing!! and the ATMOSPHERE!!! I might have cried multiple times just because of how happy this game makes me. it's so nerdy and cozy and cute (I played on easy, sue me I just wanted a fun time not a ripping-my-hair-out-frustrating-fights experience).
Really cute little game with tons to do and lots to explore. I love the base building and design aspect.

Very fun, it also helps me learn about the struggles of being under 5 foot and what they have to go through. My friends all suffer from this terrible disease and it helps me see the world from their point of vision. If you have friends under 5 feet play this game and learn what its like to be short

A truly unique survival experience, Now fully released we finally get the answers.
With a rich environment that will adapt if you abuse it, its 100% worth your time. The storyline so far has been fun and engaging and is now finished if you're interested. Of course the game is an open sandbox should you not be interested and just wish to play as a survival game.

Highly recommended.

P.s. If you have arachnophobia, like me, there are several stages of safe mode to make the spooders less and less spoodery <--- technical term :)
Such a good time, really immersive and flavorful. I can lose days in this game.fdddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd(cat helped write this review)
This is a great game although the story is quite short. The graphics are indeed realistic and calm.
This game is my second favorite game of all time. No Joke this game is probably one of the best survival ganes ever made.

VERY FUN.you can play as willow max pete and hoops. you turn small and you can play with 1-4 people so you have to get resources like sap and plant fiber. the more you rise up in the game the more better materials you need. so far i have played 3 hours by next week i'll probably have 24 hours hehehehe sry but i REALLY RECOMMEND THIS GAME.by the way it was in my library and i remembered the good times with my mom before we moved but we came back!so i hope you like this game as much as i did(;
A fun little survivalcraft game. Best with friends, so you can have one person tank the bugs and other players can kill the bugs.

This game is so much fun with your friends. I loved it so much! I have read a lot of old comments about connection issues when playing with friends, but this is in the past. The game is stable and has no issues. I hope there will be Grounded 2, with even much bigger world and more missions to do.
I played in beta and they switched some things around so this is my second go around, but overall the gameplay had me hooked, I loved the mechanics, overall a stellar game, excellent for friends.

Absolutely LOVED this game!!!! It was my GOTY for last year and it will be in my top 5 Favorite Games for the foreseeable future.

The wonder of learning the basics came pretty easy, but kept you challenged enough to take it slowly in the beginning. After surviving the first few days you think you have it figured out until you start to run into the bigger bugs. Spiders and Stink Bugs keep you in terror but eventually you gear up and learn to handle them, if only barely. 

Lots of challenges and variety in the different areas of the yard keep it fresh, and the story keeps you going at a decent pace. Once you think you got it all figured out and you traverse the backyard like you own it, the upper backyard opens up!! Even more glorious areas to explore, new critters to face and upgrades to be had.

When all is said and done you are almost sad to leave it all behind. Oh what the heck, lets keep working on that new Base a bit longer... There is always tomorrow. :D

I started playing this many moons ago when it was just a baby beta. Back when it only took a few hours to go thur all the content. Recently, some buds and I played thur the whole game and I'm really happy with how turned out.
Just going to start off with the things I liked the most.
The art style is fantastic and fits well with the world created. The armor sets with matching weapons are super fun to grind for. Story, also fantastic. It was fun following along and trying to figure out what happened. And the bosses are super fun to whoop on.

The are only a few minor bugs I've come across, such as the smaller bugs getting stuck in rocks and losing some arrows in them as well. Hearing other characters talk from across the yard is also kinda jarring. lol
However, the biggest and most painful issue I've had is with the multiple player.
No matter how the game is hosted other players tend to DC at random and sometimes can't even join at all, even if they've been in the same game before. At times this is such a big issue we've had to stop playing for the day.

Overall, this is a really fun game with friends or without! I highly recommend ya givin it a go! <3
Its a nice game but way too expensive for turkish players i played it on the trial mode which was fun
I love this game and have over 1000 hours on the gamepass ver. Goat survival game!

The ecology, combat system, land as well as underwater, decorating furniture, and online co-op are all well done.
It's especially handy for planning routes with spider silk.

Lots of things to fight, create, and explore. for people who like survival, combat, and adventure games this is the game for you. however if you have arachnophobia, there is a setting to help prevent phobia fright in the game settings. overall 9/10 game. would recommend

It boasts of thrilling locations and a constant looming sense of dread sandwiched in between the colorful environment. Have been playing this game right from the start, and the developers should be proud of what they have finally achieved in 1.0!

Very fun to play with friends. The game also gives you opportunity to explore new stuff and experience different combat strategy against certain insects! FUCK Wolf Spider tho

Whats not to like its fun, addicting and easy to play. I hope they introduce things into it like mice/rats, snakes, birds that we have to watch out for in late game. Perhaps family dog that comes out into the yard.

This game has everything, adventure, puzzles, survival, combat, building, teamwork or solo this game is a blast that you can pick up and put down at your leisure. No annoying dailies, or constant begging for more money, this game is just happy to be played, it doesn't require your every waking second.

Maybe this is one of those games you really need friends to enjoy. But I found it to be a near constant dispenser of frustration. Not even with difficulty, though that did finally end my play right at the end of it. Just the CONSTANT running around looking for materials. The constant pauses as you wait for stamina to recharge. Constant interruptions from aggressive bugs that seem to be there for no reason other than to keep tripping you up.

First half of the game, the lower yard, was interesting. Once I got to the upper yard, though, I just wanted the whole experience to be done.

This game is worth more than I paid for it. This is literally one of the best survival games OF ALL TIME. It's as good as Terraria and Minecraft. I've been playing off and on since 2020, and I remember when the best weapon was the Mint Mallet and the best armor was Ladybug armor. This is an amazing game and I highly recommend it.

This game is addicting and really fun, but if you were to play this game, definitely play it with friends, Playing this solo is very time consuming and can be very tedious especially when you fight harder enemies. Other than that this is a phenomenal game! 5/5

The game started out WAY too kid based for me at first, but over time it has matured into an extremely fun and polished game....and it still isn't anywhere near finished. The team working on this game seem to be an amazing group and REALLY listen to their players and make compromises to keep as many people happy as possible without sacrificing their vision of what it should be. I'm in for the long haul on this one :)

This game is one of the best survival games. Progression isnt grinndy, but it need time.
You shoude deffenetly play this game.

It's my first time with a world building type of game like this, so I cannot compare it. But it's an exciting game with heart pounding moments. Those wolf spiders will really give jump scares and the koi fish can too. It features an arachnophobia mode for those with that condition. I don't know how it affects the sounds they make. I don't use it when I play.

4/5 is the rating I'd give it. It has a bugs life vibe at first but then it slowly gets unsettling as you progress through the storyline. The crafting system is pretty good compared to other games and building doesn't have certain annoying limitations. Combat is pretty easy until you hunt the big bugs but they aren't impossible to beat. The game is also full of exploration and full of discovery that you wouldn't think possible from a ant sized human being. The only reason it's not perfect in my books is due to the lack of other insects or animals that you expect to see like a centipede. A big one at that would be pure nightmare fuel. All in all great game, highly recommend especially in multiplayer. Dynamics can be.. interesting to say the least.

This game is super fun, my only gripe is that if you are playing multiplayer and your friend starts the game, you will not receive any achievements. I have 29 hours in this game and not a single achievement. Wack!

It's a great way to spend time with friends making Honey I Shrunk the Kids jokes and laughing at bug antics. Also if you have arachnophobia then I do not recommend since the spiders are the size of a friggin car compared to you.

I really love this game!

My boyfriend and I prefer different types of games - I like RPGs and he likes survivalist games - so we generally don't play together. I asked him if he wanted to try this one because I was scared to play it alone lol, and it became a fast favourite. It's a fun premise, with interesting challenges and a cool world. It's a good middle ground for the both of us.

A super fun and pretty unique game. It's still in early access, so there are some bugs (both as in insects and glitches) and unfinished features. That's to be expected. No game is ever completely free from bugs; especially early access titles. Personally, haven't found any glitches that are too game breaking beyond the occasional bug getting stuck or having some funny AI at times.
I think the ability to customize your experience to your preference fantastic. If you want to just freely build and explore, you can. If you want an extreme challenge where everything can and will kill you in moments, you can do that too. There's also the option to customize your world to your exact liking with a good number of settings. The depth of the settings and customization alone is fantastic so everyone can play exactly as they want.
The gameplay itself is fascinating too. The world is vast but not overwhelming and full of life. You can explore and build in about every square centimeter of the world. Personally, I find the base building the most fun. There are features I wish were added or were changed absolutely, but I know new features are being added regularly and it's still early access. I'm very glad I decided to pick up this game

The game is a well made survival game. Of course, it sets you as shrunken teens in a backyard to survive and find your way home. Game not recommended though if have entomophobia or arachnophobia. Though there is a arachnophobia mode to reduce spider appearance. The game has good survival features, interesting exploration and an okay story plot. The part of having to grind, kill some same insect types more than once for different Tier tools gets a little repetitive boring though. But at least the building your way of your house is a fun constructing time and when completed, you feel proud of effort. Overall, the game is a good survival game. Recommend if it like survival games.
Beat it once mild EZ attempting to beat it Woah Got one tapped by an infected larva 10/10 game Would recommend

Future Classic. amazing team, great style, and super solid gameplay from the foundation. setting new standards for the survival genre AND making a game that is fun for just about everyone. as a friend of the studio, I've been helping to test this game since the beginning, and it is _always_ a delight.

I'm not an Arachnophobe but this game might just make me into one. Besides that, I love it! Survival and building are definitely my favourite kind of games and you got both in this game. Who would have thought that going through your backyard at this tiny size, could be such an adventure?
If you have played Raft, Subnautica or No Man's Sky, I think you will like this one too.

tldr.text: Very Positive (92%): players praise the story, the characters, and the combat most.
The main complaint is bugs and crashes, which 27% of reviews complain about, and some say they make multiplayer unplayable.

details.text: Newer players are 61% positive, while long-time players are 97% positive, so the game lands better with those who stick around.
Recent reviews are 90% positive, about the same as the all-time score, so opinion has held steady.
